resources.name: CP2K (Open-source DFT code with hybrid functional and NEB support)

access.notes: Standard CP2K distribution including GTH pseudopotentials. Supports PBE and HSE06 functionals and CI-NEB.
Atomic coordinates for β-Li3PS4 from Homma et al., Solid State Ionics 182, 53–58 (2011). Required to construct the LiCrS2/Li3PS4 interface.
